cells.tense: Right now you are the one who decides, and the deciding is clean because you have waited until it was.
cells.ask: Offer one thing you are certain of without adding a reason, and let that be the whole gift.
cells.core:
You decide from a place that has already weighed the truth, and you wait until it is solid before you move. When the direction forms, it arrives complete, which is why it convinces people without your raising your voice. The clarity comes before you have spoken, so the speaking can settle things rather than announce them. You are free to hand it over and step back, letting others pick it up from where you set it down.

Because you are comfortable not knowing yet, the picture does not need to be finished for you to act. You take the next clear step and leave the rest dark, and the people near you can feel how much light that actually gives. What you build holds because you built it from what was true, not from what was loud.
cells.sheetLine: You decide well and you say it once, and it is enough.
cells.place: where the road shows itself only a step at a time

cells.tense: Somewhere ahead you can already see the finished argument and you are living there, ahead of the room you are standing in.
cells.ask: Pick one open question and leave it open for a day, watching what the not-knowing does on its own.
cells.core:
You are reading the pattern before it is there to read. The shape you expect arrives first, and the people in front of you are answering a version of the question that only exists in your projection. So you push the decision that has not come yet and you fill gaps that were still opening.

Nothing is allowed to stay unfinished for a moment. Instead of forcing the answer, try letting one thing remain unanswered and notice it does not collapse. What comes back when you stop finishing the sentence for them is the information you could not have supplied yourself.
cells.sheetLine: You are answering tomorrow's question while today's is still being asked.

cells.tense: The call was yours to make and it stayed at the door you walked past, so things have been running on nothing since.
cells.ask: Decide one small thing that already needs deciding, only for this week, and let that be enough.
cells.core:
Where the direction is clear you can read it, and the reading is accurate. The next step shows itself and you take it without needing the whole picture, and that much is working. You are not lost. You are just not saying what you see.

What is missing here is the saying. You hold the call, and the people around you are left to guess at it, so everything drifts toward the choice that asks least of anyone. Start where the work is small and real: one decision, made for the people in front of you. What returns when you make it is yours, and you can carry it without explaining yourself yet.
cells.sheetLine: You see the decision and you have gone quiet about it.

cells.tense: You are already steering the shape of this, and you keep handing the language over to the room rather than keeping it for yourself.
cells.ask: Name one decision you made in the last week as yours, out loud, to the person it affected.
cells.core:
The ones around you are getting their order from somewhere, and that somewhere is you before you have admitted it in words. You move and the pattern responds. Then you describe it as if the plan arrived whole, or as if things simply worked themselves out, and the claim slides off the one it belongs to.

The authority does not become heavy when you claim it. It becomes steady. One sentence said plainly, to the person it touched, is enough for now. You hold it, and the people around you hold it with you, because the room already knows whose hand it has been.
cells.sheetLine: You set the order and you keep calling it no one's plan.
